title: TestSpec
description: Test specification for all API functions. Produced before implementation. Source of truth for test authorship and independent verification. Version 3.0.0.

fnRef.description: Function ID from ApiSpec. Format: FN-camelCase, e.g. FN-createUser

testCategory.description: Which category of test this is.

reqId.description: Functional requirement identifier, format REQ-NNN. Must match an ID in GoalSpec.

nfrId.description: Non-functional requirement identifier, format NFR-NNN. Must match an ID in GoalSpec.

scId.description: Success criterion identifier, format SC-NNN. Must match an ID in GoalSpec.

concreteValue.description: A concrete example value — string, number, boolean, object, or array. Must NOT be a placeholder like 'a valid userId' or 'some string'.

glossaryRefItem.description: A text item with inline glossary references.

glossaryRefs.description: Glossary term identifiers (GL-NNN) referenced in this item.

fcId.description: Function coverage entry identifier, format FC-NNN (3-digit zero-padded).

usId.description: User story identifier from GoalSpec, format US-NNN-slug.

ujId.description: User journey identifier from DesignSpec, format UJ-NNN-slug.

scrId.description: Screen identifier from DesignSpec, format SCR-NNN-slug.

version.description: Semver version of this test document instance.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the TestSpec schema this document conforms to. Must be '3.0.0'.

project.description: Must match project name across all other specs.

apiSpecVersion.description: Version of the ApiSpec this test spec was authored against.

dataSpecVersion.description: Version of the DataSpec used for type resolution.

status.description: Lifecycle status of this test. One of: draft, confirmed, deprecated.

verificationStatus.description: Whether the independent clean-context verification step has been performed.

functionCoverage.description: Per-function coverage summary. One entry per function in ApiSpec. Used for completeness assessment.

fnRef.description: The function this coverage entry summarizes. Must match a function ID in ApiSpec.

happyPathCount.description: Number of happy path tests for this function.

edgeCaseCount.description: Number of edge case tests for this function.

errorPathCount.description: Number of error path tests for this function.

outOfScope.description: Explicit list of behaviours this function's tests do NOT verify. Required — prevents false failures during verification.

glossaryRefs.description: Glossary term IDs (GL-NNN) referenced in this coverage entry.

id.description: Unique identifier for this function coverage entry

name.description: Short descriptive name for this function coverage entry

description.description: Plain-language description of what this coverage entry captures

reqRefs.description: REQ-NNN IDs from GoalSpec functional requirements covered by tests for this function.

tests.description: All test cases across all functions.

id.description: Unique identifier for this test case.

name.description: Short descriptive name for this test case (e.g. 'Export report as PDF').

fnRef.description: The function this test exercises. Must match a function ID in ApiSpec.

category.description: Test category: happy_path, edge_case, or error_path.

description.description: The scenario being tested in plain language.

input.description: Concrete input values keyed by parameter name. Every required parameter from ApiSpec must be present. Values must be concrete — no placeholders.

expectedOutput.description: The exact expected return value or shape. Required for happy-path and edge-case tests.

expectedOutputType.description: The type name of the expected output, for cross-spec validation against DataSpec.

contractClause.description: Which part of the ApiSpec contract this test verifies. Quote or paraphrase the relevant clause.

reqRefs.description: REQ-IDs this test verifies. Include when the test directly validates a requirement. Omit for technical tests (error paths, edge cases, infrastructure).

errorCode.description: Required for error-path tests. Must match an error code documented on this function in ApiSpec.

expectedError.description: For error-path tests: what the caller receives.

code.description: The error code the caller receives (e.g. NOT_FOUND, UNAUTHORIZED).

returnType.description: The type of the error object or exception the caller receives.

messageContains.description: Optional substring the error message must contain.

notes.description: Optional clarifying context for this test case.

glossaryRefs.description: Glossary term identifiers (GL-NNN) referenced in this test's description and contractClause.

scRefs.description: SC-IDs from GoalSpec that this test helps verify. Populated when success criteria are written. Use for TST→SC traceability.

nfrRefs.description: NFR-IDs from GoalSpec that this test helps verify (e.g. performance benchmarks, reliability checks).

status.description: Lifecycle status of this test case.

entityRefs.description: ENT-IDs from DataSpec entities used in this test. Used for data type validation.

constraintRefs.description: CON-IDs from ArchitectureSpec constraints tested by this test case (e.g. performance, reliability).

usRefs.description: US-NNN IDs from GoalSpec user stories that this test validates.

ujRefs.description: UJ-NNN IDs from DesignSpec user journeys that this test covers end-to-end.

screenRefs.description: SCR-NNN IDs from DesignSpec screens that this test interacts with.

goalSpecVersion.description: Version of the GoalSpec this spec was reviewed against.
